test_title: PYST 177: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, F, G, H, I, J and K , are standing opposite to each other in a circle, facing towards the center. F and G are adjacent to each other. F and K are opposite to each other. H is opposite to I. J is opposite to G. K is second to the left of H. Who is standing between F and I ?
solution:
According to the given information:

Six people, F, G, H, I, J and K , are standing opposite to each other in a circle, facing towards the center.

2. F and K are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a423280a7544d92e46e0361a7c70ec533c324bb19f7305bc228507cd71b49a5.png] 

3. K is second to the left of H and H is opposite to I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9eabac6a126eec123a731f66ddf2616f8f01adb6bd3cb09b2d1d75e833588b7.png] 

4. F and G are adjacent to each other and J is opposite to G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/498e87ab6d0e548ae94b634423b82a1215e9a4526f9cabdcf7a61abd992e2f89.png] 

∴ Here, 'G' is standing between Fand I.

Hence, the correct answer is **"G".**
